provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: low, wide decorative floor prop for a side-view 2D exploration platformer; one connected raster sprite-like asset
Primary request: Create exactly one connected asymmetrical scatter of fallen votive stone tablets. Include exactly three thin, cracked prayer plaques lying nearly flat at distinct shallow angles, a few flat chipped masonry flakes integrated into and touching the same overall composition, and exactly one loose dark cord woven continuously through and around the plaques so the entire prop reads as one connected unit.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha; the prop is fully isolated with no depicted environment.
Style/medium: production-quality 16-bit pixel art, chunky deliberate pixel clusters, crisp hard edges, strictly pixelated forms, no smoothing and no antialiasing.
Composition/framing: 3:1 landscape canvas representing three 32-pixel tiles wide by one tile tall. Center the complete prop horizontally. Show the entire silhouette without cropping. Ground the silhouette precisely at the bottom anchor. Keep all visible material below half of the one-tile canvas height, so it is clearly shorter than one quarter of a two-tile-tall player. Spread the plaques across most of the width with irregular gaps and an asymmetrical low rhythm distinctly unlike a cluster of broken urns. The cord must visually connect the separate stone pieces into one composition; no extra disconnected pieces.
Color palette: dark navy and indigo shadows, muted blue-purple stone, sparse cool blue edge highlights; restrained low-saturation palette.
Materials/textures: thin weathered stone plaques, subtle cracks, chipped edges, compact readable pixel clusters. Plaque faces may have abstract shallow wear marks only, never readable writing or recognizable symbols.
Lighting/mood: minimal cool edge illumination encoded in sparse pixel highlights; no cast shadow.
Constraints: exactly one connected prop; exactly three prayer plaques; one continuous dark cord; a few masonry flakes incorporated into the connected silhouette; complete subject visible; transparent background; decorative-only visual with no collider implied; flat and very low profile.
Avoid: upright headstones, upright or tall slabs, spikes, bones, skulls, urns, broken urn rhythm, sarcophagi, readable writing, letters, numerals, glowing runes, pickups, hazards, floor plane, ground line, pedestal, cast shadow, scenery, environment, text, UI, border, frame, watermark, extra disconnected objects, photorealism, painterly rendering, blur, gradients that soften pixels, smoothing, antialiasing.
